name: Souda Love Revolution
source:
The game resolves around Souda Kazuichi’s day, trying to express his love for Sonia, but he can’t do that without your help… OR you can make him fall into obvious traps to see one of the 7 Bad Endings the game offers you other than the True Good Ending!

[From [url=http://amc-art.tumblr.com/post/94192727862/souda-love-revolution-is-out-the-game-resolves]amc-art's Tumblr[/url]]
translation:
游戏围绕Souda Kazuichi的一天展开，他试图表达他对索尼娅的爱，但如果没有你的帮助，他就无法做到这一点……或者你可以让他落入明显的陷阱，以看到游戏为你提供的7个坏结局之一，而不是真正的好结局！

[来自[url=http://amc-art.tumblr.com/post/94192727862/souda-love-revolution-is-out-the-game-resolves]amc-art的Tumblr[/url]]
